fetchChoice: Fetching every {minutes} minutes is not one of the choices.
notFound: {path} is not a folder Haunt can find.
notProject: {root} is not a project or a git repository.
notListed: That is not an open tab or a repository Haunt lists.
stillScanning: The code is still being scanned: try again in a moment.
scannerLate: The scanner did not answer in time.
fileNotScanned: That file is not in the scan.
fileOutside: That file is not in the repository.
notShown: That repository is not the one shown.
scannerStopped: The scanner stopped. Save a file or rescan to start it again.
watchLimit: The system's limit on watched folders was reached, so saving some files will not rescan. On Linux, raise it with: sudo sysctl fs.inotify.max_user_watches=524288
typescriptNote: The TypeScript compiler installed in the folder ({version}), used to read its code with its own settings instead of Haunt's copy.
typescriptNoteUnknown: The TypeScript compiler installed in the folder (of an unknown version), used to read its code with its own settings instead of Haunt's copy.
scriptNote: Run by the scanner with Node, to sort the code into layers.
hookNote: Run by git when Haunt does what triggers it.
huskyNote: What the hook above hands over to.
